:knowledge-point/questions.:question/problem:
Mark is traveling on his sailboat through a lake. Every $30$ minutes he records his coordinates on a map using a GPS navigator. The data that he collects is shown in the table below. The coordinate system is set up so that the positive horizontal axis is aligned with the East and the positive vertical axis is aligned with the North.

| Time | Coordinates |
| --- | ---: |
| $8:00$ am | $(-3, 0)$ |
| $8:30$ am | $(-5, 2)$ |
| $9:00$ am | $(-2, 2)$ |
| $9:30$ am | $(-2, 4)$ |
| $10:00$ am | $(3, 2)$ |
| $10:30$ am | $(0,-1)$ |

During what time period did he travel North?

:answer-field/choices.:answer/value: From the cinema to the church
From the stadium to the cinema
From the theatre to the fire station
From the depo to the hospital
From the fire station to the stadium

:knowledge-point/questions.:question/problem:
The table below shows the coordinates of bus stops in a town. The coordinates are set up so that a difference of one unit corresponds to a distance of $1km$.

| Stop Number | Location | Coordinates |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| $1$ | Depo | $(4, 0)$ |
| $2$ | Hospital | $(4,-2)$ |
| $3$ | Theatre | $(2,-2)$ |
| $4$ | Fire Station | $(2, 3)$ |
| $5$ | Stadium | $(-3, 3)$ |
| $6$ | Cinema | $(-3,-4)$ |
| $7$ | Church | $(0,-4)$ |

If it takes precisely $5$ minutes for the bus to travel from one bus stop to another, then between which two bus stops is the bus going the fastest?
